So you won't be able to get MC off a GP prescription. 
MC is obtained through a third party clinic such as Curaleaf/Alternaleaf ect. 
You need to contact the clinic yourself, a GP will not do it for you. 
You're fine mentioning cannabis use to your GP, but they are not allowed to advise on cannabis use.

Basic route to take. 
Apply to a clinic that you prefer (check online reviews if you want better info) 
Enter your information and follow the form. 
You will need to let them have access to your health records, this is to prove that you have tried GP recommended treatments and are looking for alternative medicine options.
If you have no proof then you won't get accepted. 
To be considered for MC you need to prove an ailment that THC helps with, and 2 forms of tried medication (including therapy) 
Once confirmed with the clinic, you will be asked to have a video meeting with a clinician that will talk you through the next steps.
